source_evidence: D327~10:55 player exact 'Yes' following companions' agreed recommendation to inform Desen first and keep Halvessa's proposed 15:00 appointment. V/Mara/Cirren/Fenar walk together from Old Crown Ward to Western District Watch annex, meet Sgt Rill Desen and report the actual audience and offered Sallow introduction. Ordinary travel and report; new time estimate for ordinary city movement and conversation, no check or new expense. Companions independently confirm Halvessa's exact statement: 'Sallow has standing instructions from me. Some of the goods we buy are landed before assessment. I know the duties are not included in our bills.' They explain her offer to introduce the party through Sallow to Tavosk and proposed 15:00 appointment. Desen records the report and identities of the four firsthand witnesses as a lead to be checked alongside existing evidence, not a sworn deposition, signed V statement, independently authenticated household exhibits or conviction. He advises that if they go back, listen to what Sallow actually offers, avoid promising illegal purchases or revealing evidence, do not attempt arrest, and leave if the meeting becomes unsafe; he will continue official corroboration. No police deputization, covert surveillance, warrant, deployment, arrest, new fee, restitution or recovery of money. Desen now knows the admission and offered appointment, not hidden prep or unobserved facts. V has indicated intent to keep proposed appointment, not actually attended or confirmed Tavosk's presence, agreed to a deal, or chosen intervening activity. Meeting with Desen concluded for now; group together outside annex ~10:55; next decision before 15:00. No resource changes.
